content.short: ZIION is the first comprehensive solution for blockchain security testing and development.
content.description: ZIION is an open-source, all-in-one security toolkit featuring over 100 tools and utilities for Solidity/EVM and Rust-based blockchains. It aims to democratize blockchain security by equipping both developers and security professionals with practical testing capabilities. This toolkit supports a wide range of products—from simple dApps to full-scale blockchains—and enables thorough evaluation, hardening, and validation across multiple chains and environments. Its open nature invites community contributions and transparent security auditing.
